title: Flying Over Adair
content:
Flying over Adair, Iowa, I wonder if there’s someone way down there in that little town who loves to draw and paint from their imagination...
...someone who is the creative “weirdo” in their family, and who hopes someday to meet other artists who totally understand how it’s possible to dream with your eyes open.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)
